column1: # Bulgarian (bg) catalog. Same format as zh-hant.tsv:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
# (empty context = a plain UI string; `@id` = a command id; `@plural` = "one|other" English forms,
# translated as two Bulgarian forms "one|other"; see `plural` in i18n.rs).

# ordinary Bulgarian vocabulary of vector illustration (работна област, път, опорна точка,
# дръжка…); no Illustrator (or any other application's) Bulgarian UI, string table or localisation
# resource was consulted or copied. Drafted with AI assistance (Gemini) from the English meaning;
# not yet reviewed by a native speaker.
